headline: The 7-Man Epic: Matt's Brother-Combo Hat-Trick & The 6-All Thriller vs Bonsai
rawSmsText:
Our opponents, Bonsai tonight.

The last time we met, early this season, they got us 4-5.
They were young (teens) and fast.

We had a few missing tonight as Reece (recovering from injury and overseas holiday included), Mitch (You know, the self inflicted cut finger), Peter ( The Flu), Joel ( apparently nail in foot at work), and Mack (Sick bay).
Wow. 5 missing.
So, our remaining 7 will have a real challenge in this game.

We won the toss and the Bonsai team kicked off. We would be coming down hill in the second half. With the ball.

They attacked us with their number 11 jumping around and teasing us. Well, it worked as he wangled a way over to put it down for the opening try. 0-1.

They attacked us again as Dylan showed up and made a great try saving tag.

Cam took control and carried the ball into our attacking zone.
But when things turned around , Matt made a nice tag out wide to keep them at bay.

Their overzealous number 11 went forward again and threatened our tryline. His pass went forward and  the referee saw it.

Jayden broke through their defensive line and sent a long pass out to the left where BJ was waiting. But it was too far behind BJ.

We attacked again and Cam was very lively as he sent the ball  beautifully along the attacking line to Dylan and he turned to put it down but the ball seemed to drop over the line and it was paid that way.

Soon after, BJ dived to make an important tag but just missed and they went over. 0-2.

We managed to attack with some excellent speed and took the ball all the way to where Jayden was ready to run it over but not this time unfortunately.

Adrian stood up and took a strong pass from Cam giving us more opportunity.
Their number 11, who we no longer like because of his lack of respect for anybody, ran at us but Jayden got him.
Good stuff.

We attacked and we always go close. Jayden got 6 more as they were penalised. Soon after, Cam got the ball to his brother, Matt, and he made no mistake in placing this ball down. Try.
1-2.
Great defence by Dylan and Jayden caused the Bonsai guys to drop it. Game on.

In attack, BJ, out wide , called for it and Jayden threw a lovely high strong pass out wide to BJ but it went over his head. Bugger.

Dylan got a nice touch on them allowing Jayden to look for and find a rampaging Cam. Of course, Cam put it down safely for a very nice try.  2-2.

At this stage, we have to remind ourselves that we have one substitute, and they have about four. Young blokes.

We are going well.

Then they seemed to score quite  easily but the referee saw a forward pass.

Nev and Adrian took the ball up through the middle, as they tried their hardest to help in this effort.

Jayden was particularly agile and keen tonight and as he dived over for a well deserved try, he got a faint tag.

It wasn't long before Cam, attacking with flair, found his brother again. Matt put it down very quickly. 3-2.

We continued to put pressure on them as the half time siren sounded.

HT 3-2.

A great score line considering our team numbers tonight.

We showed our confidence with Cam finding Jayden early to put another on the scoresheet.
4-2.

This situation must have ignited them as they attacked us with speed.
And they went over. 4-3.

Our blokes were suffering a little, not that you would know, but Adrian was limping in some considerable pain. (Calf muscles).

Consequently they scored again fairly easily at this time. 4-4.

Matt made a desperate, great tag but they continued on their way.

A good run forward by our team looked really good but they came back at us very quickly and scored. 4-5.

Cam, Jayden and Dylan tried really hard to score.
But, you know what. These young blokes got very dodgy weavy and went through us to score again.
4-6.

Cam wasn't done and placed the ball into his brothers hands again.
And Matt put it down. 5-6.

Then, Jayden ran a perfect line through their defence to score a beauty.  6-6.

Only a few minutes to go but we were tiring. Such a great effort so far.

You can't stop him. Jayden making every tag possible.

We still made the necessary touches with BJ front and centre.
Cam and Adrian got busy and went forward. But, they ran through us as we looked a little tired. 6-7.

Cam, Matt and Jayden continued to fight and some really good tags kept them out. 
One tag by BJ on their number 11 was especially good.

We attacked once more but as the ball went to ground , the referee said  "Play On". Well, the Bonsai team grabbed the ball and ran the length of the field to score one more. 6-8.

Wow.
With only a couple of minutes to go, we were 6 all.
Against a strong young team.
And we were missing 5 of our great players.

This has to be one of the best ever games by any team ever.
So well done.

headline: Young Blokes at Heart: 5-3 Victory Despite Parking Chaos & The Casualty Ward
rawSmsText:
For tonight's game we were missing Reece (long term injury).
Also Peter (Respiratory problems) and Mitch (Self inflicted cut 😂requiring 5 stitches in his finger).

So we had 9 players but started the game with 6. Cam, Matt and Jayden arriving a few minutes after the start. Parking is a severe problem at the moment at this venue.

We actually started the game well and defended strongly until Mack grabbed a nice intercept at their tryline.

This gave us some attacking momentum and Joel and Dylan combined beautifully to put down our first try. 1-0.

They then retaliated, ran the ball to our line, with Mack and BJ doing their best to keep them out but no. They scored. 1-1.

Joel attacked and threw the ball out wide to Adrian but the ball went behind him and we gave it up.
Joel, as usual, was on fire and made a great tag to stop them in their tracks.
Cam threw a nice cutout pass to his brother, Matt, and we went further forward. This opportunity opened things up for Joel and he went over for our second. 2-1.

They responded but threw a long ball out wide but it was ruled forward. They appeared to be a bit desperate as they threw another good attacking ball wildly and down.
Matt threw a confident strong pass out to BJ and he grabbed it with both hands. Really well.
This great play led to Cam going forward at speed and passing over to Jayden who made no mistake as usual. 3-1.

Of course they responded quickly. But Dylan and Jayden made decisive touches to shut them down.
Joel attacked and threw a fast pass to Dylan and he accepted it.
We looked good.
Then following keen support from Jayden, Cam simply ran through them to score our next try. He made it look easy. 4-1.

Then, Cam got us 6 more. Penalty.
We attacked as Cam passed well to Matt and he looked to go over but was deemed tagged.
Then, as we defended Matt tagged really well. 
Joel and Jayden defending on the line looked to have done enough but no. The referee indicated a try. It must have been a very close thing. 4-2.
Seconds later the half time siren sounded.

HT 4-2.

Obviously we were in a strong position and we earned that.
Adrian got us 6 more as we attacked them.
Joel was looking to score and passed to Dylan and he made no mistake and put it down. 5-2.

Nev made a great tag on the line and came back to make another to totally keep them out.
Matt and Jayden defended well together in the midfield.

Cam ran through them and looked likely to put another one down but was deemed tagged.
Then, on the far right corner, the ball seemed to be dropped by somebody. But, unbelievably a try was given to our opponents.
5-3.

We counter attacked but BJ, Jayden and Adrian were all tagged.

A great run by Nev through the middle gave us good field position. Matt took the ball and went over. Disallowed. Apparently tagged.

Next thing, Cam, without the ball was tackled. Well, both players involved were sent off; a soft send off where they can be replaced. And only need a couple of minutes off and then run back on.

We continued to attack and Dylan, having a wonderful night, put it down, having a clear run to the line. But then, after some discussion between the two referees came the unbelievable decision to disallow the try.

Jayden , Cam and Dylan weren't done. We attacked.
Then after another great tag by Adrian this evening, Mack got the ball and took it up.

Joely, still fired up, made a try saving tag.

We defended once more and Nev stood tall as he "left" (A Great Leave), the ball to allow possession to be ours.

Only a few moments later, the game was over.

FT 5-3.

Summing up.

Everyone played well tonight.
We have a great range of ages of our players. We always did.
But, everyone tonight played like young blokes. 
Good job. 👍

headline: Brave Battle Against The Touchers: 4-8 Shootout Against the Speedy Youngsters
rawSmsText:
Tonight's game saw us play The Touchers who were another young group of players.
We were missing Reece (injured), Matt, and Jayden (injured).
So we had 3 subs.

We started well with Cam attacking in the middle and he found a running Mitch out wide and he ran over and put it down.
1-0.
A good run up by Peter looked promising but his pass fell to ground, unfortunately.
Further good runs by Adrian and Nev gave us some momentum.
Then, the speedy Touchers went over a little too easily. 1-1.

Joel was looking really keen as he often does and he dived over the line but got tagged.
Cam got the ball not far out and looked around for someone. Eventually he found Joely, attentive to the situation, and he very quickly rushed to the line and put it down. 2-1.

We continued to play well but when they attacked us with interest, we gave them a big gap to run into and they did. 2-2.

Peter was keen to take the ball up in the midfield and he dodged and weaved his way forward. Soon after however, they received a nice intercept pass and ran without interference to the tryline. 2-3.

Following this disappointment, Cam got busy and ran to the line only to be tagged at the crucial moment.
Mack took the ball up well and then accepted a very low pass to give us another chance.
We were defending fairly grimly at this stage, but Mitch ran very determinedly to make a great tag.

Another intercept pass found their fast number 8 guy and he was always going to score.
And he did. 2-4.

Cam and Peter tried to get one back but it didn't work that well as they grabbed another intercept pass. And as we didn't pursue them, they simply passed the ball around until they found a chosen one on their team who just placed it for , maybe, a life long goal.
2-5.

Then. Siren.

HT 2-5.

Cam and Joel were singular in their efforts to score and they attacked. However, the Touchers got the ball , dived and scored. 2-6.

Cam, always looking for someone to achieve, found a falling Peter but he grabbed it and grounded it and got us an important try. 3-6.

Mack got interested and with Adrian made some good ground.
Then Dylan almost got through to score but not this time.

The Touchers were strong , and young, and quick, but a great tag by BJ saved us. And then his father, Nev , made the necessary move to stop them scoring.

A very nice catch by BJ from Cam was inspirational. It was quite a long pass. Then Joel kept popping up and stopped them yet again.
Peter ran on and made a very important tag to keep us in it.

They attacked us and looked dangerous. Adrian made the tag but it was disallowed. They scored. 3-7.

Cam and Dylan run riot , trying to turn this around.
Peter receives a nice intercept pass to give us a chance.
Again, Cam and Dylan were tagged. Then, Joel almost got there.

They attacked us but BJ tagged them to give us a "touch and pass" penalty.
Then Joel nearly made it through to score. And again , he was tagged as he slid through to score for us.

Dylan was still looking fit as he looked to score.  We weren't done as Cam and Joel had other ideas.
Joel dived over to give us our 4th.
4-7.

With only seconds to go, they attacked our line and as we stood back, showing the line, they put it down.
4-8.
And that was that.

We are playing some terrific teams this season. We need to enjoy the experience.
And we will.

headline: The Gallant Win: 6-5 Buzzer-Beater Over 'Hunt and Kill' (And No Way Was It A Draw!)
rawSmsText:
So tonight it was Hunt and Kill.
That's their name.
So that will be our endeavour.

Everyone has showed up for this game except for Reece who is handling a serious injury.

They kicked off and we held them well after they attacked us with irreverence.

Joel and Dylan took us deep into attack early. We then defended well as Cam grabbed an intercept pass and ran easily (walking for the last bit) for over half the field to score. 1-0.

Adrian was looking lively as he took the ball forward through the middle and made some good ground. Soon after , they attacked our line when Dylan made a quite spectacular touch on them to deny a certain try.

Matt made a nice tag at the line but a forward pass ruling was enough to stop them.

Some nice attacking play gave Joely a chance and he passed to BJ on the wing. Unfortunately it was deemed forward.
We attacked again as Cam found Joely and he stretched out to score but got tagged.

Next thing. They attacked us with incredible speed and found a big gap in our defence, and put it down comfortably. 1-1.

Matt took a great catch , down low , as we advanced.
However, they combined really well to approach our line and simply went over to score. 1-2.

Nev used his time on the field to take the ball up into their defensive line and looked to pierce it. He made excellent ground but was tagged eventually.

We got the ball back in the middle and Joely rushed forward only to be pushed in the back ( by some coward) and we were given the penalty.

Another attempt at scoring was when Cam sent the ball to Peter who dived over but was tagged in flight.

HT 1-2.

We had the ball and went forward.
Jayden wasn't happy with the way things were going. He got the ball about 20 metres out and just hung back causing some confusion. The very "wiley" Jayden then simply created the gap and ran in to try. 2-2.

Our defence was standing up as Dylan made a crucial tag on the line. This was followed by a good run forward by Matt. Then BJ and Adrian made a try saving tag on the line.

They got the ball back and threw it right across the field and scored. 2-3.

Cam and Joely took the ball and went forward at speed.
The ball came back and Peter tagged well and again and again.

Joely went forward with the ball and threw a nice long ball out to Nev, but it was too tough to take.

BJ made a great tag to stop them.
But a really long throw to their winger on the other side of the field, enabled them to score quite easily. 2-4.

Jayden, obviously obsessed with winning for his team tonight, hung back again after receiving the ball , and then literally "walked " through their defensive line, and scored effortlessly.
What a fantastic effort and statement for our team.
Fabulous. 3-4.

Peter was fouled in a "play the ball" and with their field position they scored soon after.  3-5.

Peter then attracted heavy attention and was awarded a penalty. Great.

We weren't done when Matt and brother Cam combined to put one down. A very speedy put down by Cam. 4-5.

With only about 5 minutes to go, they attacked us with great determination, but spilled the ball. Thank goodness Jayden was on the field as he collected the ball and ran , with some enormous determination.
He ran all the way to provide us with a chance to win. 5-5.

A tag in defence by Adrian was crucial. They might have scored.

Then the referee couldn't cope any more with the pushing and shoving by both teams but , mostly by them.
Unfortunately for Mack, he was binned as well as their number 13.
Mack was probably sucked in by this provocative "smart arse" player.

headline: Rain, 'Nifty Nev', and One of the Great Tries of All Time in a 4-5 Thriller
rawSmsText:
We were missing Reece and Joel tonight and Cam and Matt were running late.
We looked at our opponents and saw a group of young, 15ish, players who were probably well drilled. And fast.

They had the ball first and went deep into attack. Surprisingly no score though and we attacked them through BJ, Mitch and Cam.
Next thing, they just swept past us and put it down. 0-1.

Adrian got the ball in the middle and made some very good ground.
Matt and Jayden combined well and very nearly scored.
Jayden was on fire and was tagged on the try line twice.

Of course , the game went end to end with both teams moving the ball fast. (And Furious).

Then, they appeared to drop the ball over the try line but the Referees paid the try. When the main ref came off  to mark the try, he shook his head and said "it's one of those things". 0-2.

Cam, looking very determined; maybe they thought he was dummy half, but he calmly went over and put it down. 1-2.

Cam was busy and passed to BJ and their contact on him gave us a penalty. However, they attacked with purpose and when Peter slipped over, they took off and ran most of the field to score another.
1-3.

We defended quite well but Adrian was obstructed and we were given the penalty. Very good refereeing.

Back on the field after a break, Jayden made a great tag to keep us in the game.

HT 1-3.

We had the ball for the start of the second half. And what happened next is a little unbelievable.

Peter took the tap and ran the ball forward to where he could give it to Mitch on the left wing. Peter made plenty of ground and Mitch had a lot to do. Mitch ran at his normal speed, (flat out), and he very narrowly missed being tagged about 3 times as he placed the ball down for one of the great tries of all time. 2-3.

Soon after, this very speedy team of youngsters, ran a great angular line to ensure a nice try. 2-4.

Cam was smart in defence as well as our attacking leader. He smacked the ball down to deny them.

Jayden was always alive to any situation and sent a strong pass out to Dylan. Well, what a great catch that was.

They attacked us with venom, often, and on this occasion, BJ made the miraculous touch to shut them down.

As I said earlier, the ball went up and down the field as both teams were constantly in attack mode.

You can't hold him down.
Nifty Nev. He runs it toward the line until, ok, I must pass.
Well, he found young Mack who just put it straight down for a very nice and welcome try. 3-4.

We kept attacking with Cam finding Mitch, who is always looking lively. And he caught the pass beautifully.
Then, Mack and BJ worked well together to make some really important tags.

Jayden was serious as he made about 30 metres on his own.
About 10 metres out, we got the ball out to Adrian but it just slipped through his hands.
Remember, it's raining. The ball is wet.  

You couldn't keep Jayden out of this game as he dived for a try but was tagged unfortunately.
We were keen as Cam dived over but was also deemed tagged.

You know when things aren't going that well but then a great low down catch is taken to keep our momentum, then Adrian did it. On his knees.

Matt came on and with Nev (you know Nifty), made some very good ground.

Amazingly, after some really good defensive work, they strolled over for a well earned try. 3-5.

He can only thank those who gave him the ball so near to the tryline.
Because, he dodged and weaved, and showed the ball , just like Nifty has always done, and fell over the line to score a really wonderful try. That was Adrian.
4-5.

Cam, fantastic in defence as usual, as the siren went.

So, the final score was 4-5.
A very nice game against some very fast and young players.
Of course, we wish them great success in the future.

FT 4-5.

headline: Knockout Final Glory: 7-4 Triumph Over The Hungarians & 11-0 Undefeated into the Grand Final!
rawSmsText:
Well, we finally got back onto the beautiful green fields to play Touch footy. After all that rain.
Apparently over 200mls for May.

Peter is here but can't play due to his hamstring injury.
Nev can't play due to his surgery but is also interstate so can't attend.
As with all good highly competitive teams, we had quite a few supporters show up to watch.

So, with 10 (4 subs) we were ready to play in this knockout final.

We kicked things off with a nice attacking play. And then they had their chance and also attacked quite well. The ball went up and down the field with no great threat to either try line.

Then Reece was keen to go over but was tagged unfortunately.
Mitch ran on off the bench and "requested " the ball and he showed great determination as he took the ball up towards the target. His speed was amazing.

Jayden tried really hard to run around them but was tagged just as he was about to score.
Mitch then ran at the line and he was tagged also.

Some good lead up play got the ball to Reece and he ran and delivered the ball to BJ on the far left wing. BJ, running furiously towards the line grabbed it and held it and put it down in the corner for a great try. 1-0. 

Of course they attacked us with purpose and found our right wing defence  largely undefended.
Luckily their long throw out wide was unsuccessful as the ball went to ground.

The Hungarians were full of running and attacked our line again. This time Joel and Mitch did everything possible to tag them but the referee paid their try. 1-1.

We attacked with good speed and Jayden threw a nice, fast , long pass out to Mack on the left wing but he couldn't drag it in. Mack would have scored.

Another nice attack by us with Reece supplying Adrian with a chance to score and it looked as though he did. But no. The referee declared a touch was made.
Reece then went on his own to the line and was deemed touched also. No luck.

Then Matt looked really confident as he made a great defensive tag. But no, as the referee made a very delicate decision. Matt was not happy. They had scored. 1-2.

Cam ran on and got very busy.
The ball went down but Cam continued and just created a situation where the gap was wide enough for him to rush and put it over. 2-2.
Seconds later the siren sounded for half time. 

HT 2-2

We were hopeful that the Hungarians would tire and make mistakes. Well, they dropped the ball on the first play after we resumed. At the half way line.

We didn't take full advantage of this as Reece had to make a big tag to keep them out.

Bailey looking to score dived but fell awkwardly and might have injured his member. Not sure.
Good luck with that mate. 

We were playing with a little more desire as Cam found a way through. Nice one. 3-2.

Joel was just brilliant tonight in defence.

They attacked and threw a forward pass near the line but the referee didn't see it. 3-3.

Their best player, the 14, young girl, was absolutely fabulous as she controlled their attacking game. But she missed tagging Jayden and strolled over for a well deserved try. 4-3.

Now, a super attack by Cam and Reece got the ball out wide to Mack who held it beautifully and put it down so well, in the corner. 5-3.

Then, not to be outdone. Bailey took off in the midfield with exceptional speed and wasn't troubled as he scored a beauty.
6-3.

Their young girl, a seriously good player, attacked us but we were able to shut her down. Jayden was so keen to defend and he did.

Joel and Reece worked well again to keep them out. And our big tag was not realised and they scored .
6-4.

Then, something special for us as we watched in disbelief as Jayden and Mitch passed with great intensity to get it to Reece and he made it look easy as he scored for us. 7-4.

They attacked us on the left flank but Adrian was there and made 3 important tags to slow them right down.

The siren went to give us the win needed to go through to the Grand Final.

FT 7-4.

A hard fought win against a team who really wanted to surprise us.

We have now remained undefeated this competitive season. 11 Zip. So good.

Tonight's game was against the Screws, one of the stronger teams in our comp.
We had 10 players with Peter to arrive a little later. Nev is out with a hospital visit to treat his melanoma. Good luck Nev.

We were given the ball and Bailey and BJ took it up fairly quickly into attack.

Then, all of a sudden, Cam ran it forward in the next set and found an eager Bailey who, cleverly, ran wide of their defence and put it down for a nice early try.  1-0.

Of course they attacked us with intent but Jayden, Reece and Joely closed them down with some great defensive teamwork.

Adrian then made a great tag as they tried to attack down the wing.
We attacked well again and Joely dived over but was tagged in flight.
Then, Mitch excelled with his tag to slow them down.

We went forward quickly and Jayden showed his fleet footedness to score quite easily. 2-0.

In defence, Adrian and Reece put great pressure on them and they bombed a certain try. They continued to attack our line but Mitch grabbed an intercept pass and ran over half the field, quite quickly, to the line; chased all the way. Success. 3-0.

The Screws were noticeably upset at the state of play and looked to be more competitive.

Cam and Reece put in a great effort to defend our line.

We then attacked with speed as Matt threw a nice wide, fast,  pass out to Mack, running well in support. Unfortunately, he couldn't control the catch and the ball went down.

After an obvious Touch and Pass by them, the referee did not give BJ the opportunity of running the ball out of trouble.
Cam was everywhere to be seen in our defensive area.

We then had our chance to go deep into attack and Reece was instrumental creating this huge opportunity and found Bailey who made no mistake in getting it down. Just brilliant. 4-0.

Adrian and then Mitch tagged well to keep them at bay.
Joely and Jayden also worked hard to stop them in their tracks.

Cam and Reece got busy and ran the ball miles forward only for Reece to step out on the left wing.
Bugger.

Peter arrived and ran on to make an extremely important tag at the siren for half time.

HT 4-0.

They had ball first this half and ran into attack.
We were short at our right edge in defence and they were good enough to pass and put it down for their first try. 4-1.

We attacked and Mack was involved in getting us a penalty with them failing to clear the ruck.
Then, Joely got the ball and jumped with glee as he evaded their attempt to tag him. Got it down safely. 5-1.

We were in good control of things at this stage. Peter, Cam and Jayden made sure that we maintained our supremacy by going forward with some speed.
BJ and Reece. And Cam and Jayden worked hard to maintain our advantage.

Then, some really nice moves by Bailey, Joely and then over to Reece and he made it look easy as he planted our 6th try.
6-1.
Soon after however, they attacked us really well and found a gap in our defence out wide again on our right side. 6-2.

Both teams, looking a little tired, faltered with mistakes causing a change in direction of play. Both ways.
This malaise did not affect Reece as he received a ball from Cam near the try line and turned, brilliantly, inwardly to score another great try for us. 7-2.

Peter, BJ, Joely and Adrian were on the field at this time and defended gallantly to protect our lead.

As the game neared its ending, Mitch made a great try saving run and tag  on their right wing.
They responded by rushing at him and pushing him, forcing him to the ground. Naturally, Mitch was not happy with the extra attention. The referee was not in a mood to look after us at that moment. And he sent Mitch to the Sin Bin. All he did was protest to the push as being unnecessary.

Our team members were a little incensed at the situation and walked, calmly, onto the field.
Thinking it was over.

But they had to retreat from the field so that the game could continue because the referee gave the Screws a penalty.
Quite messy really.

Anyway, the game then ended with some acrimony. Unnecessarily.
It's ok. Mitch is ok. Just a bit bewildered like all of us.

FT 7-2.

An absolutely amazing win.
Like all the others this season.

Our team members were a little incensed and walked calmly onto the field thinking it was over, but had to retreat so play could finish. Quite messy really. Anyway, the game ended with some acrimony. It's ok, Mitch is ok, just bewildered like all of us. FT 7-2! Amazing win!

headline: The 4-3 Comeback Thriller vs Timball: Mitch's Last-Gasp Tag & Reece's Winner
rawSmsText:
Last week, the game started with some great movement from Mitch , in particular, as he raced towards the tryline.

Then we attacked again as Jayden found Adrian out wide but no score this time.

They attacked us with purpose and it took a smart Cam to make the try saving tag. BJ tagged really well also to keep them out.

We took the ball up well into attack again but they grabbed the intercept ball and "long legs" opponent ran extremely fast to the line to score first in the game.
0-1.
It wasn't long after though that Cam threw a long cutout ball to Adrian on the left wing and he held it well and put it down carefully. 1-1.

Mack and Adrian were looking keen as they combined to take the ball forward. Jayden threw a long pass out to BJ, again on the left wing. He caught it well near the try line but had no time to put it down.

Of course they attacked us and looked to score. Joely made a great tag near the line but it was not given and they had scored. 1-2.

Nev and Mack ran on and got busy in the middle. This gave Joely a chance and he dived over the line but was deemed to be tagged. No try.

They attacked us relentlessly but this time Jayden was there to tag their dummy runner. Our ball.
They attacked again and Mitch made sure they didn't score at the line.
Then some great teamwork saw us defend some very strong attacks.

Joely was tagged again as he dived over. So close.

Then, Joely, fired up, made a great try saving tag to keep them out.

A nice catch by Cam in defence kept them out again and that took us to the half time break.

HT 1-2.

Our half time chat with Cam, Jayden and Joely speaking , was positive as we tried to stay focused on our game, not theirs.

Once again, they sent their girl player forward and she looked likely to score but Cam made sure she didn't. Then Jayden shut down their attack.

We went up the field quite swiftly giving Reece a big chance to score and he dived for the line.
Unfortunately for us, he was tagged. Probably in the air.

They looked pretty keen to get us but Mitch tagged well. Then Mack made a tag near the line but it was too late apparently so they scored another one. 1-3.

We raced the ball up the field and Bailey dived but just got tagged.
We then got lucky when Joely got the ball and was able to run through their defensive line because they were offside.
He put the ball down and scored our second. 2-3. Game on.

They attacked again and when about to score , Reece moved forward and made the try saving tag.
Cam and Jayden then took the ball out of trouble.
Nev and Mitch made further ground to put us in a good attacking position.
Defending well, Mitch got their dummy and we had possession.
Then, unbelievably , Mitch dummied and weaved his way to the tryline and over. 
So well done. 3-3.

Did I say Game On? Yes.

So amazing to see Joel, Cam and Reece just fly and that's what Reece did. He flew over the tryline and scored.
4-3.

Only a couple of minutes to go and we were in front for the first time in the game.

The Timball team were losing it as they clashed with the referee.
We put so much pressure on them , it worked .

Peter stepped up and tagged their girl who was about to score .
Then Reece was tagged in the air as he flew over the tryline.
Again, Peter put pressure on them  and this resulted in a touch and pass decision for us.
At a critical moment.

Mack, Mitch and Jayden then set off to protect our eventual dominance in this game. They took it forward beautifully but we gave the ball over to give them one more chance to score.

Only minutes or less to go and  they ran through us and looked likely to get the equaliser.
Mitch wasn't having anything of it.  He ran and made a remarkable last gasp tag to save us.

The final siren rang out and we had won.
FT 4-3.

Wow. What a fantastic game.
Another one.

Still undefeated this season.
storyParagraphs: The game started with great movement from Mitch racing towards the tryline. Jayden found Adrian out wide, but no score. Timball attacked with purpose, requiring smart try-saving tags from Cam and BJ.

We took the ball up into attack again, but they grabbed an intercept ball and their 'long legs' runner went the distance to score first. 0-1. Soon after, Cam launched a pinpoint cutout ball to Adrian on the left wing, who held on well and put it down carefully for 1-1.

Mack and Adrian made ground, and Jayden fired a long pass to BJ on the wing who was tagged just before grounding. Timball counter-attacked, and despite Joely making a great tag near the line, it wasn't awarded and they scored. 1-2. Joely was then denied twice diving over the line. Joely and Cam made try-saving stops to take us to the break. HT 1-2.

headline: 9-4 Demolition of Old Foe Ice: Jayden's Kickoff-to-Line Wonder Try & Mitch's Brace
rawSmsText:
Yep. I must have blinked, as soon after the game started,
Jayden had put one down. He was too quick for them after he dummied and ran to the line. 1-0.

We were up against Ice tonight, an old foe. They're usually pretty good.
We have the full squad with 6 on and 6 subs.
A very cool evening and a fairly dry field having had no rain for a while.

Cam and Matt worked the ball forward and looked likely to score but not this time.

BJ made a nice try saving tag to keep them out.

After a good buildup, Mitch, stepping well, and Joely run the ball to the try line but couldn't get it down.

Peter got the ball around the half way line and passed very quickly to surprise them and we progressed well.

Peter then grabbed a nice intercept pass and found Reece who was called through by the Ref, even though tagged. It was play on as Reece took full advantage and scored. 2-0.

Adrian took the pass on the right wing and found himself retreating a little before he got the ball to Jayden. Well he just ran, as he does and put it down carefully for another one. 3-0.

They attacked us and Matt, defending a large gap, couldn't make the required tag and they went over. 3-1.

Nev dummied and made some good ground but they got the ball in the middle and strolled over for another. 3-2.

The next play saw Bailey grab the ball in centre field and just take off. Of course he scored, with ease. 4-2.

We defended well after this with Mack making a safe tag, setting us up for the next attack. And we attacked well as Joely dived over, successfully. 5-2.

Bailey and Peter took the ball up but not in time to beat the half time siren.

HT 5-2.

We had to defend early in this half as Mitch was in position and took control.
Then, Mack turned it on and made some excellent ground for us.

Jayden and Cam got very busy in the centre, took it forward and found a willing BJ who quickly put it down. 6-2.

They attacked us with great purpose but Bailey had none of it as he single handedly closed them down.

However, soon after, they attacked us again through the middle and dived for the line successfully. 6-3.

Peter, looking as fit as a fiddle, ran forward and found Adrian out wide on the left wing but he couldn't control the ball and it fell to the ground. So close to scoring.

Mitch ran on off the bench and called for it. Got it and ran forward and gave it to Peter.
He ran further forward and looked to get it back.
He did and ran to the line for a great single minded play and a nice try for us. 7-3.

Cam and Matt attacked their line again but, unfortunately, too much pressure to catch the winning ball.

They were about to score but Mack disturbed their catcher, on the right wing, enough to get the ball back for us. Great effort.

Mack then combined with his brother, Mitch, to take us well into attack.

We then had to defend. 
Joely made a great try saving tag but the tag that Bailey made was disallowed and they scored. 7-4.

You know what, Jayden is quick.
But, to watch him run from the kick off in the middle of the field and go all the way to the tryline is amazing. This reminds me of a great similar try by Nev some years ago. It is a very rare thing.
8-4.

Of course, we then had to defend.
And defend we did with Cam and Adrian doing their best to maintain our dominance.

Reece, Cam and Adrian then put together some good attacking play. Joel got involved but couldn't quite finish this time.

A big run through the middle gave Peter a chance but he was tagged  at the line.

Joely and Bailey with some dashing play took the ball forward quickly and found Mitch who relished the opportunity and put it down for our ninth try for the night.

9-4.

The siren sounded.
Another fantastic win.
storyParagraphs: I must have blinked, because as soon as the game started, Jayden had put one down. He dummied and ran to the line—too quick for them. 1-0! We were up against old foe Ice tonight, usually pretty good. Full squad available (6 on, 6 subs) on a cool evening and dry turf.

Cam and Matt pushed forward, and BJ made a nice try-saving tag to keep Ice out. Peter got the ball near halfway, fed quickly, and then snatched a sweet intercept pass, offloading to Reece who was called 'play on' by the referee and scored! 2-0.

Adrian worked the ball on the right wing to Jayden, who just ran as he always does and placed it down carefully for 3-0. Ice struck back with two tries through midfield gaps to narrow it to 3-2. Then Bailey grabbed the ball in centre field and simply took off, scoring with total ease for 4-2. Joely dived over successfully before halftime. HT 5-2.
Mack turned it on with excellent ground, and Jayden and Cam worked through the centre to find a willing BJ, who quickly put it down for 6-2. Bailey single-handedly shut down a dangerous Ice attack.

Mitch ran off the bench, called for it, fed Peter, received it back, and showed single-minded determination to score our 7th try! 7-3. Mack then disturbed their right-wing catcher to win back possession, teaming up with his brother Mitch in attack.

Bailey had a tag disallowed which allowed Ice to score for 7-4. But then, Jayden produced pure magic: he took the ball straight from the kickoff in the middle of the field and ran ALL THE WAY to the tryline! Reminded Graeme of a legendary try Nev scored years ago. Rare and amazing! 8-4.

headline: Back-Flicks & Blue Boots: 8-4 Victory Over Lasers 2 as Joely Bags a Hat-Trick
rawSmsText:
Tonight we played a team struggling a bit. Lasers 2.

However before the game started , Cam and Reece noticed that one of their previous team players was in the Lasers team and he was very good. Extremely good. He will be known from here as "Blue Boots".

We started the game quite well as we rushed the ball forward. I reminded myself to "don't blink because you might miss it" moments.
And it happened. Bailey got the ball, deep in attack, and dummied, and ran , and dived to score early. One minute in.
1-0.

Not long after, in a defensive position, Joel grabbed it well and ran forward. He passed to Reece who ran extremely fast into an attacking position. He decided to throw a long ball way across field to where Matt was running all alone. A good throw, a good catch and, consequently a good try.
2-0.

They then attacked our line and, miraculously, their player grabbed a pass with one hand and dropped to the ground and it was over. 2-1.

We were still looking keen as Mitch dummied and went forward quickly. Of course his fleet of foot was too much for them as he scored easily. 3-1.

Then we had to defend again as Adrian showed great determination to stop them.

We attacked with Nev taking it up nicely. And then Peter took it up further. But then we defending again. Nev had to stay wide to stop them going around to score.
Joel was great in defence showing a lot of determination tonight.

But then, their "Blue Boots" guy ran at speed over the try line and looked for a teammate. He found him. 3-2.

We counter attacked as Nev passed to his son, BJ, but he just got tagged.

Peter, looking very lively tonight, attacked with purpose and found Bailey who dived over for his second try tonight. 4-2.

Cam ran on and attacked full on, got tagged , but also got the ball away to Reece who ran with absolutely no chance of stopping him. A nice late try to make to score look really good. 5-2.

HT 5-2.

After the break, they must have had a plan. Because they attacked our line really well and found BJ short when he tried to tag them at the line. 5-3.

Peter and BJ got busy and sent the ball out to Bailey who found a very keen Joel out wide and he put it down 6-3.
Soon after , we attacked again and Bailey fired it forward over to Joel and he dodged and weaved his way beautifully to the line , untouched. 7-3.

Of course they attacked us with their chance to do so.
But two great tags by Mitch and Peter kept them frustrated.

We attacked with Peter, on fire tonight, getting the ball away to BJ who looked to the line. But he was tagged. Very nearly scored.

Joely, also on fire tonight, dived for the line , but got tagged at the crucial moment.

Cam, Reece and Mitch combined to close them down when they looked dangerous.

We went back into attack when Cam ran forward over the try line and threw an unbelievable back flick to Joel and he actually grabbed it and put it down safely.
Quite amazing. 8-3.

They attacked us again with serious intent. Reece knocked the ball down at the line. They hadn't scored.
But then their "Blue Shoes" threw a brilliant pass along the try line to find one of his teammates.
Successfully down. 8-4.

Great defence from Reece caused them to drop the ball.
Peter and Cam then continued with our great defence to take us to the final whistle.

FT 8-4.

We missed the tremendous contribution by Mack and Jayden tonight, so things can only get better.

Another fascinating and exciting game from the boys at the Point Takeaway team.
storyParagraphs: Tonight we played Lasers 2. Before kickoff, Cam and Reece noticed that one of their previous teammates was playing for Lasers—and he was extremely good. He will be known from here as 'Blue Boots'.

One minute in, Bailey got the ball, dummied, ran, and dived to score early! 1-0. Soon after, Joel intercepted, fed Reece, who launched a massive cross-field bomb to where Matt was running all alone. Great catch, great try! 2-0.

Lasers pulled one back with a one-handed miracle catch. 2-1. Mitch answered immediately, dummying with fleet footwork to score easily for 3-1. Nev and Peter made good ground, but 'Blue Boots' sliced through to set up their second for 3-2.

Nev linked with his son BJ, and Peter found Bailey who dived over for his second try of the night! 4-2. Cam then powered through and offloaded to Reece, who charged in unstoppable for 5-2 just before the break. HT 5-2.
In the second half, Peter and BJ sent it to Bailey, who found Joely out wide to score for 6-3. Soon after, Bailey fired it to Joel who dodged and weaved untouched for his second! 7-3.

Mitch and Peter frustrated Lasers with clutch tags. Then came the highlight of the night: Cam surged over the tryline and threw an UNBELIEVABLE BACK FLICK to Joel, who grabbed it cleanly and put it down for his HAT-TRICK! 8-3!
'Blue Boots' set up a late consolation try for Lasers, but Reece, Peter, and Cam locked down defense to the final whistle. FT 8-4! A great win for the Point Takeaway boys!
